# Catch That Idea soundtrack

All demo sounds are external recordings / foley, not generated by Motionroom's synthesizer. Used only by the default demo, outside the sound library.

- Kenney, RPG Audio (CC0): https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio — book/page handling, cloth, door and creak.
- Kenney, Impact Sounds (CC0): https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds — wood, concrete and grass footsteps; soft landing, thud and desk tap.
- Thimras, Park ambiences (CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/park-ambiences — birds and wind field recordings in Adelaide. First 15 seconds trimmed, faded and compressed to MP3.
- Kresiek The Furry, AMB Rain Loop 1 (CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/amb-rain-loop-1 — 15-second rain excerpt, faded and compressed.

Kenney license files follow.

## Revision 18: action-specific edit
- Luckius, Various Paper Sound Effects (CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/various-paper-sound-effects — paper_sound_-_1, _2, _3 used for lift, fold and crease. Trimmed to activity, filtered to remove rumble and harsh top end; short click-prevention fades.
- rubberduck, 40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX (CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/40-cc0-water-splash-slime-sfx — splash_09 for the visible puddle landing, trimmed and filtered.
- Existing Kenney footsteps: softer filtered versions with trimmed leading silence, synchronized to rig foot-contact phases.
- Rain/birds: continuous crossfaded location beds. No wind/cloth/creak/impact sound layers for imaginary effects or expression changes.

## One More Try (v19)
- `basket-bounce.mp3`: **BasketballBounce.wav**, Blankened, CC0 1.0. https://freesound.org/people/Blankened/sounds/505628/ . Public HQ preview; trimmed 39 ms leading silence and tail, faded tail.
- `basket-net.mp3`: **basketball through hoop.wav**, 21100495, CC0 1.0. https://freesound.org/people/21100495/sounds/655323/ . Public HQ preview; first net contact excerpt at 0.40–0.63 seconds, edge fades.
- Both records retain the source licenses; no synthetic replacement is used. Other paper, foot, cup, and bird recordings are credited above.

## Extended story (v20)
- `cafe-murmur.mp3`: **Cafe ambient sound.mp3**, evsecrets, CC0 1.0. https://freesound.org/people/evsecrets/sounds/332271/ . Public HQ preview; 25–39 second excerpt, band-limited 160–3200 Hz and edge fades; mixed quietly as café conversation.
- Indoor beds use the existing **Quiet room tone** preset (`sfx:night-room`) from the app's Night story library, as requested. It is generated locally; all other demo sounds are recordings.
